method: Agent source review; representative qualifications selected before the revised candidate was generated. This does not establish independent human acceptance.

checks.qualification: Availability inferred from a postal area remains provisional until the complete address is checked.
A provisional design cannot trigger a nonrefundable deposit without explicit review of the applicable terms.
A declined or interrupted payment must not produce a false paid-order confirmation.
A request submission is not treated as an approved order amendment.
A partial arrival does not mark the entire order as complete.
Closing a logistics task does not automatically close an unresolved customer support case.
A cabinet cannot be silently resized to make it fit a wall; any suggested substitution needs customer acceptance.
Restoring a version does not imply its old price or availability is still valid.
An unresolved warning follows the design into consultation and cannot disappear from a purchase summary.
A visually fitting 3D model cannot by itself certify installation feasibility.
A consultant edit never silently replaces the customer's saved version.
A concept with unresolved critical fit warnings cannot be presented as fully order-ready.
An approved future price does not alter an already accepted order without the applicable agreement.
A low-confidence supplier update cannot become an exact promised date.
A design with unaddressed fit warnings cannot be marked approved merely because a reviewer opened it.
A draft quote or customer note cannot be mistaken for a confirmed production instruction.
A user who can draft a discount is not thereby authorized to approve it.
A support suggestion is not published as product fact without specialist review.
A product with missing dimensions is not shown as an exact match and is clearly marked for manual confirmation.
A provisional supplier estimate cannot be rendered as a guaranteed delivery date.
A retired finish is not silently exchanged for another; the customer receives a clear replacement decision.
An unconfirmed room measurement remains marked as approximate in the consultant's view.
A manually entered dimension is labelled customer supplied until checked during consultation or survey.
A shared link does not expose private address or payment details.
